sources.title: Qarvexium/QED-Base-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: QED-Base-v2 QED-Base-v2 is a ~107M parameter causal language model pretrained from scratch by Qarvexium. It is a base model — it has not been instruction-tuned or aligned for chat, and will continue text rather than follow instructions or hold a conversation.
